title: Cellular-automata caves
summary: Random rock smoothed by one neighbour-counting rule turns into caves. An interactive version of the technique from Herbert Wolverson's procedural map generation talk, traced to the talk's slides and code.

revisions.note: First version, written to test the site's Astro prototype.
